entries.text: There are rumors about some kind of army. I think the Elders# want to concentrate their resources on the ones that are already# far enough along in their training to make a difference if we# do have a big battle on our hands.

entries.text: 听说外面有邪恶的大军。元老们想用把那些原来就有基础的战士集中训练，让他们能再上个台阶，如果有恶仗要打就能派上用场了。

entries.text: We strongly believe that training a few fighters extremely# well is better than giving mediocre training to a bunch of# fighters. Saving lives is one of our primary objectives.

Don't you think I should# be given training if I want or need it, or do you only 'say'# it is your primary objective to 'save' lives?
